user_saw: Release operators saw beta qualification fail before child jobs started because ClawHub package reads exhausted their retries.
summary: The fix adds a fourth ClawHub read retry with a 30-second backoff so package reads can recover after four consecutive HTTP 500 responses.
reasoning: I checked that the July implementation already used the 1-, 3-, and 10-second schedule for release package reads, and that HTTP 500 became retryable under that same schedule days later. The fix PR reports that ClawHub endpoints recovered shortly after the existing retries were exhausted, indicating that longer upstream outages exposed the retry limit.
